Work in /opt/nxeon (Next.js/TS, live prod tree). You OWN the ADMIN live-chat / support inbox pages + components ONLY (app/admin/chat, app/admin/support, components/admin/ChatInbox*). Do NOT touch the sidebar/topbar/widgets, the admin email page, or the customer-facing ChatWidget.

Board card cmsu3nha "Live chat dashboard — needs to be better/more organized":
1. **Message attribution + styling**: in a conversation, messages from support and from the customer currently look identical (same colour, same side). Separate them — customer vs staff on opposite sides with distinct styling, like a normal chat UI. AND show **who sent each staff message**: whether it was a specific **admin/agent** (by name) or an **AI** message (the bot). The ChatMessage sender field distinguishes visitor/agent/bot; surface agent identity (assignedTo / author) and label AI messages clearly.
2. **Search bar** to filter conversations.
3. **"Close all"** option to bulk-close conversations.
4. General organization/polish of the inbox list + reading pane.

A screenshot may be at /opt/nxeon/board-uploads/board/cmsu3nha3001lhlgutdeiz3g5/ — read it with the Read tool. Study the existing components/admin/ChatInbox.tsx and the ChatMessage/ChatConversation schema (sender: visitor|agent|bot; assignedToId; and bot messages come from the AI agent).

Constraints: do NOT run `npm run build`/`next build` — verify with `npx tsc --noEmit` only. Match existing styling. Report: files changed, what each does, tsc result.
